body:
Phase 5 (final): mob.LoadDungeonRosterOverride + data/dungeon_roster.json, real compiled-in fallback preserved. 3 new tests. GFD commit 3711fdb, IDUNA commit a4bd381 (admin GUI). This closes the whole 5-phase MOB_SPAWN_NORTHSTAR.md plan: zone grid math, spawn toggles (+ fixed the real Hills/Caves-never-spawned bug), the toggle GUI, difficulty-tier variants, and now dungeon roster editing -- all 4 admin GUIs (Items, Mob Drops, Mob Spawns, Dungeon Roster) live in IDUNA, all cross-linked, all live-verified.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-MOBSPAWN-001 fully closed: all 5 phases shipped
